down, downwards.
I. C. gen. (WM, § 47, k; Bl., § 42, 2).
1. C. gen. rei, in local sense;
(a) down, down from: , , , ;
(b) throughout (late usage; Bl., § 42, 2): κ. ὅλης κ.τ.λ., , ;
(c) in a peculiar adjectival phrase: ἡ κ. βάθους πτωχεία, deep or extreme poverty, .
2. C. gen. pers., usually in hostile sense;
(a) against (in cl. only after verbs of speaking, witnessing, etc.): opp. to ὑπέρ, ; μετά, ; after ἐπιθυμεῖν, ; λαλεῖν, ; διδάσκειν, ; ψεύδεσθαι, ; after verbs of accusing, etc., , , , al.; verbs of fighting, prevailing, etc., , , , al.;
(b) of swearing, by: ὄμνυμι κ. (Bl., § 34, 1), , , cf. .
II. C. acc. (WM, § 49 d; Bl., § 42, 2).
1. Of motion or direction;
(a) through, throughout: , , , al.;
(b) to, towards, over against: (Field, Notes, 62), , , , al.;
(c) in adverbial phrases, at, in, by, of: κατ’ οἶκον, at home, ; κατ’ ἰδίαν (v.s. ἴδιος); καθ’ ἑαυτόν, , , ; c. pron. pers., , , , al.
2. Of time, at, during, about: , , , al.
3. Distributive;
(a) of place: κ. τόποὐς, , al.; κ. πόλιν, , , al.; κ. ἐκκλησίαν, ;
(b) of time: κ. ἔτος, ; ἑορτήν, , al.;
(c) of numbers, etc.: καθ’ ἕνα πάντες, (on καθ’ εἷς, v.s. εἷς); κ. ἑκατόν, ; κ. μέρος, ; κ. ὄνομα, .
4. Of fitness, reference, conformity, etc.;
(a) in relation to, concerning: , , , , ; κ. πάντα, , , , ;
(b) according to, after, like: , , , , , , , , al.
III. In composition, κ. denotes,
1. down, down from (καταβαίνω, etc.), hence, metaph.;
(a) victory or rule over (καταδουλόω, -κυριεύω, etc.);
(b) "perfective" action (M, Pr., 111 ff.).
2. under (κατακαλύπτω, etc.).
3. in succession (καθεξῆς).
4. after, behind (καταλείπω).
5. Hostility, against (καταλαλέω).
